layouts.name: M-Sport long variant

This exact independently mapped source-node course retains the long southern section and a northern round-return variant. Combined with the complementary inner variant it preserves the actual northern circle, northern triangle and southern alternatives shown in the supplied configuration shape. The descriptive variant name is not an official timed-layout designation; historical alignment and direction remain draft.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The supplied proving-ground shape depicts the northern circle and triangle and multiple southern alternatives. The operator identifies the 2.5 km proving ground, eighteen anti-clockwise configurations and a steady-state circle; its aerial photograph independently confirms the northern circle, triangle and southern course alternatives. These two complementary exact source-node cycles retain every independently mapped closed-course branch in that footprint. Preserve their physical configuration set, shared edges and real junctions; do not interpret its unique branch distance as a timed lap or adjust coordinates to the catalogue scalar. Descriptive component names do not assert official layout names, and exact historical timed branch choice remains unverified. The independent unique branch distance is 3082 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
